update.notes: Happy Thanksgiving! 0.4.2 Beta brings a quick dodge roll (off by default; with it on, the Jet Skates need a gamepad's left stick press first), better lock-on, cheat codes you can switch while playing, new Teleport names, more detail farther away, and fixes for Mega Man Legends. IMPORTANT: this in-app update replaces the launcher only. To get the game changes, download the new Setup or zip, then press Build my game again. A short guide in Flutter Deck explains the new features. A record of recent play is kept on your PC to help find bugs. Nothing is sent. You can turn it off in Settings.
